items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: Do you remember the Paramount Theater where Frank Sinatra had that whole thing with the bobby soxers?

ctx.x: When was your first opportunity to record?

I think the first, well the first professional record date I did was I was working at Childs’ Paramount Restaurant on Broadway and 43rd Street. It was downstairs from the Paramount Theater. Do you remember the Paramount Theater where Frank Sinatra had that whole thing with the bobby soxers? There was a restaurant downstairs called Childs’ Paramount, and I was working with Henry’s band, and I got a call from a guy named Teddy Reig, who was a, did you know that name?
Yeah, a big producer. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
